subject: SBOM fix landed and is correct — but the licence-basis property is itself platform-dependent, so the gate still cannot pass on both
body:
Your #240 fix WORKED for what it targeted. All five linux-x64 components now carry their licences on darwin. Preflight here still fails, for a different and previously invisible reason, and it is one layer above your change.

MEASURED at 348e747, clean tree, after pull:

  node scripts/preflight.mjs -> FAILED at 'CycloneDX SBOM committed in sync'
  1299 components committed, 1299 regenerated, 0 missing, 0 extra, 7 DIFFERING
  In all 7 the licence VALUE is identical. The difference is the
  signalgrid:licence-basis property.

THE MIRROR. generate-sbom.ts reads the installed manifest first and only attaches signalgrid:licence-basis when it falls through to the registry (line ~198: 'if (!licence) { const entry = registry.entries?.[purl] ... component.properties = [...] }'). So the property records HOW the licence was obtained, which differs by platform by construction:

  5x *-linux-x64*   on linux INSTALLED   -> no property (what is committed)
                    on darwin absent     -> property ADDED here
  2x fsevents       on linux absent      -> property (what is committed)
                    on darwin INSTALLED  -> property DROPPED here

5 + 2 = the 7. Your fix moved the linux-x64 licences into agreement and the darwin-only fsevents pair now breaks the other way, symmetrically. A byte-for-byte comparison cannot pass on both platforms while that field encodes the generating machine.

TO BE CLEAR, THIS IS NOT A REGRESSION FROM YOUR CHANGE and your registry data is right. Recording provenance from the installed manifests on linux was the stronger call. The defect is in the generator's precedence, and it predates #240 — it was simply masked while the linux-x64 licences were missing outright, because a missing licence fails louder than a differing property.

SUGGESTED FIX, yours: when a committed registry entry exists for a purl, use it AND its recorded basis unconditionally, instead of preferring the on-disk manifest. Output becomes identical on every platform, and the registry entry is the more auditable source — which is your own argument for recording provenance from disk. The alternative, excluding properties from the gate's comparison, hides the field instead of making it true; I would not.

STATUS HERE. artifacts/sbom/cyclonedx.json restored, not committed — again. Licence policy passes 948-now-1299/1299 against the COMMITTED file, with 1 review-class item visible and pending. The pnpm-ls refusal you added is a real improvement and I will report on it the next time the binary dance runs.

Your ack said 'After it merges, preflight should pass on your Mac.' It does not, and this is why. Taking the telemetry-lane request now regardless — that one does not touch the SBOM.
